proposed_action: Disable direct messaging permanently for all users under 16 to comply with legal requirements.
raw_reasoning:
Disabling direct messaging for all users under 16 affects a specific group of users’ ability to use a platform feature. Users (or their guardians) typically would not reasonably expect to be asked for explicit consent for age-based compliance actions, since the change is intended to meet legal requirements rather than reflect their preferences. Therefore, consent is unlikely to be required; this is more like an enforcement/eligibility policy update.
